---
title: "股票风险与收益的简单分析"
author: "李沐霖"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## 1.加载包

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
```

## 2.导入数据

```{r}
data("EuStockMarkets")
stock_df <- as.data.frame(EuStockMarkets)
colnames(stock_df) <- c("DAX","SMI","CAC","FTSE")
stock_df <- stock_df%>%mutate(time=1:nrow(.))
head(stock_df)
```

## 3.数据重塑

```{r}
stock_long <- stock_df%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols=c(DAX,SMI,CAC,FTSE),
    names_to="index_name",
    values_to="price"
  )%>%
  arrange(index_name,time)
head(stock_long,10)

```

## 4.计算日收益率、20日滚动波动率

```{r}
stock_long <- stock_long%>%
  group_by(index_name)%>%
  mutate(price_lag=lag(price),
         return=price/price_lag-1)
stock_long <- stock_long%>%
  filter(!is.na(return))%>%
  ungroup()

```

## 5.分组汇总：平均收益率、波动率（标准差）

```{r}
risk_return <- stock_long%>%
  group_by(index_name)%>%
  summarise(
    mean_return=mean(return),
    vol=sd(return),
    .groups="drop"
  )
risk_return
```

## 6.画图1：收益-风险散点图

```{r}
ggplot(risk_return,aes(x=vol,y=mean_return,label=index_name))+
  geom_point(size=4,color="#4472c4")+
  geom_text(nudge_x=0.0002)+
  labs(
    title="四大股指：收益率vs波动率",
    x="波动率（风险）",
    y="平均日收益率"
  )+
  theme_bw()
```

## 7.画图2：价格走势时序图

```{r}
ggplot(stock_long,aes(x=time,y=price,color=index_name))+
  geom_line()+
  labs(title="股指价格走势",
       x="时间",
       y="价格")+
  theme_bw()
```

## 8.结论

### SMI指数平均收益更高，同时波动率也偏高，属于高风险高收益

### FTSE波动率偏低，走势更平稳，防御性更强

### 收益和风险整体正相匹配，符合”高风险高收益“的常识
